See It In Your Room

Place the four handles on the wall corners, then drag the reveal to compare.

!Important about this room view

Prototype view, not production proof. This is a visual guide for exploring placement and mood. It does not establish dimensions, panel layout, print scale, color matching, or installation conditions.

Photo quality drives confidence. A straight-on, well-lit photo with the whole wall visible maps best. Strong lens distortion, an angled camera, shadows, obstructions, or a cropped wall can make the perspective feel less convincing.

Format changes the outcome. Wide art usually reads naturally across a wide wall; tall art can leave more room visible at the sides. A small-repeat or detail-led image may look unlike a wall-scaled mural. Use this view to compare direction, then confirm composition and scale in production planning.
